t: A block-based web tool for building Android and iOS apps, with AI extensions.
steps: Find the MIT App Inventor website.
Choose the main site or the school-oriented site.
Sign in with a Google account.
Install the companion app on a device, or install the emulator.
Ask IT to approve the sign in and the install.
Build a first app with a button and a label.
Review the privacy terms before you add AI extensions.
